newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris price target raised by Goldman.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris price target raised by Goldman.

text.p: Goldman Sachs analyst Marc Cohen said he raised his price target for Philip Morris Cos Inc stock on Monday because of strong U.S. sales, and a likely stock split and repurchase by the company.
He also cited the likelihood that legal pressure on tobacco companies in the United States would ease next year.

"The operating funamentals in key businesses remain very strong, and in particular U.S. tobacco (operations) ... are producing 1996 numbers that are nothing less than spectacular," Cohen told Reuters.
